extraction_notes: 本 batch 1 deck (HPCA TB-STC paper_share) 共 7 section, 抽出 7 patterns 一一映射。跨 batch dedup: sec 01 → 存量 opening 现有版皆是「cover_title_signature + toc」通用组合, 本例封面本身即多机构论文封面(single_paper_title_authors_only)+ TOC, 故新建 opening_paper_cover_multi_author_multi_institution_plus_toc 与存量 opening_paper_cover_multi_author_multi_institution 区分(后者单页无 TOC); sec 04 → 直接命中存量 method_multi_parallel_techniques_intro_flow_detail(3 项并列技术+算法流+硬件细节, HPCA TB-STC 完美匹配)。sec 02/03/05/06/07 均为该 batch 新出、与已有 pattern 组合弧线不完全等价, 新起 id。new_archetype: solution_family_intro_dual_panel — 上蓝框主论断下方左右两 panel 并列展示同一方向的两条子路线; new_archetype: dense_vs_sparse_mac_illustration — 左右稠密 vs 稀疏矩阵×向量数值对照的 MAC 计数图; new_archetype: sparsity_pattern_taxonomy_dual_compare — 用 VS. 分隔的两类稀疏模式矩阵可视化对照; new_archetype: pattern_flaw_accuracy_drop — 顶部蓝框主论断+精度掉点数值高亮的类型缺陷指认页; new_archetype: pattern_flaw_hardware_overhead — 顶部蓝框主论断+三代表工作 bullet+额外开销红色高亮的另一类型缺陷指认页; new_archetype: paradigm_compare_dual_route — 双路线权重矩阵示意+多任务柱状图的路线优劣对比页; new_archetype: mechanism_reveal_intro — Forward/Backward 双栏乘法示意但暂不含转置公式的机制引入页; new_archetype: key_idea_bridge_annotation — 在机制图上补全公式并以底部 Key idea 结论条桥接下章的方法; new_archetype: accuracy_result_dual_table — 左右并列两张精度表(retrained/one-shot)+红色高亮关键百分比; new_archetype: hardware_area_methodology_result — 硬件方法学 bullet 列表+面积占大厂 GPU 百分比标注; new_archetype: ablation_single_component — 针对单一关键组件(如 Adaptive Codec)的独立消融表; new_archetype: overall_edp_pareto_summary — 顶部蓝框结论横幅+accuracy-EDP Pareto 散点+名词注释的能效综合收束页; new_archetype: three_column_recap_goal_insight_solution — 横向三栏 Goals/Insight/Solution 并列回收全篇论证闭环; new_archetype: future_work_preliminary_result_table — 左侧实验配置文字+右侧多方案精度对比表+目标行红框高亮的未来工作扩展页; new_archetype: single_method_dual_route_panel — solution_family_intro_dual_panel 的同义登记; new_archetype: taxonomy_dual_class_matrix_grid — 用 VS. 分隔的双类目录矩阵可视化; new_archetype: single_method_name_with_matrix_grid_examples — 方法名+维度×比例配置示意+多块矩阵实例网格; new_archetype: comparison_three_pattern_matrix_grid — 3 列并列稀疏模式矩阵对照; new_archetype: single_text_centric_argument_statement — 单条蓝框强调论断的纯文字论断页; new_archetype: single_method_problem_annotated_matrix — 稀疏矩阵+索引存储示意+多点标注问题的方法缺陷页; new_archetype: problem_solution_dual_panel — 2×2 挑战-方案对照面板配红框问题+箭头指向方案; new_archetype: single_method_encoding_bit_field_diagram — 位域编码字段拆解+稀疏矩阵到元素表的映射; new_archetype: single_text_centric_key_idea_bullet — 两级 bullet 承载 key idea 的纯文字说明页; new_archetype: three_column_summary_panel — three_column_recap_goal_insight_solution 的同义登记; new_archetype: hardware_resource_table_with_layout — 硬件资源表+分区示意联合; new_archetype: eval_setup_bulleted_with_refs — 已在既有 pattern 中登记, 复用即可。
